title: Pyramid building begins in Egypt (Djoser)
description: Added from the Generations curriculum import (Taking Africa for Jesus). Dated only by the Generations books cited below; no tier 1–4 chronology covers this event.

sorting_basis.note: PROVISIONAL: no CFAH, Ussher–Jones or Ussher date exists, so the sort uses Generations (Taking Africa for Jesus, PDF p. 18): Around 2300 BC. Pending owner decision (open question A8).
